title: S099 4.5.5 Messages with a Null Reverse-Path
parent_path: S099 4.5.5 Messages with a Null Reverse-Path

statements.subject: message
statements.description: All other types of messages (i.e., any message which is not required by a Standards-Track RFC to have a null reverse-path) SHOULD be sent with a valid, non-null reverse-path.
actions: set valid non-null reverse-path in MAIL FROM command

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In particular, such systems SHOULD NOT reply to messages with a null reverse-path
actions: suppress generation of reply message to null reverse-path sender

statements.subject: server
statements.description: and they SHOULD NOT add a non-null reverse-path, or change a null reverse-path to a non-null one, to such messages when forwarding.
actions: preserve null reverse-path in MAIL FROM when forwarding
do not substitute non-null reverse-path for null reverse-path
